title: SOS origin-signature enforcement on POST /sos
description: Spec 18.4.1: SOS MUST carry valid origin signature; unsigned/invalid silently dropped. Extend POST /sos wire body with envelope fields pubkey(32B)+seq(u64)+sig(56B SosOriginSignature wire). Verify: pubkey derives to claimed node IID, verify_sos_origin over canonical CBOR of core alert dict (envelope fields excluded), per-node monotonic seq gate, optional TrustStore TOFU pin. Failure -> 4.01 (non-success per pinned test). Update test_sos_resource.py POST bodies with signed helper; add good/missing/bad-sig/wrong-key/replay tests; flip xfail test_unsigned_sos_must_be_silently_dropped and rewrite reality-twin :290.
close_reason: SOS signature gate implemented via verify_sos_origin() in emergency.py
